`specs/pair-remote-agents/design.md` showed the `ssh` wrapper script that `mngr pair` generates with the `known_hosts` path quoted for the shell only. That is the literal output of `build_ssh_transport_command`, which now quotes the path for ssh's own parser as well, so the snippet is updated to match. The section's closing claim -- that the wrapper is immune to whitespace in every path -- only holds of the form now shown: ssh documents `UserKnownHostsFile` as a whitespace-separated list and splits the value itself.
